I will buy DAP and urea from the farmers' cooperative to use on this plot, because the land needs those nutrients to produce a decent harvest, even though it is rented. I sow seed I kept from my own harvest last year—I do not buy the new improved kinds because they cost too much and our local seed has always done well enough. My family will do all the work on this small piece of land ourselves; it is not big enough to need hired hands, and there is no water for irrigation here.
